scope: Simulated full first-through-eighth cousins only; no unrelated or half/removed/lineal hypotheses
test_sources: batch2 of each crossover model, hash groups8000..9999
group_key: cousin_number:replicate_number (excludes batch/model so matching IDs cannot cross splits)
class_prior: uniform over the eight supported full-cousin hypotheses; not a population prior
hyperparameters: Fixed before reading benchmark outcomes; no test-based tuning
zero_policy: Restore absent IDs only within validated1..50000 replicate universe documented by source definitions/README
